title: Hortay curated channel suggestions
description: Curated public-channel suggestions shown in Hortay's 'Add channel' surfaces (both guest and authenticated modes). Fetched read-only from GitHub via jsDelivr; unknown fields are ignored by the client, so new optional fields are forward-compatible.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes so older clients can refuse a payload they can't parse safely.

updated.description: ISO date of the last edit. Informational only.

defaultLocale.description: Fallback language code used for locales that have no channels of their own (a German user with no 'de' channels sees the 'defaultLocale' set plus wildcards).

categories.description: Section definitions. Sections render in 'order'; a section with no channels for the resolved locale is skipped.

title.description: Localized section title, keyed by language code. Falls back to defaultLocale, then any value.

channels.description: Channel placements. The same username may appear more than once with different (category, locales) so it can sit in a different section per language.

username.description: Public @handle without the leading @. Case-sensitive for display; matched case-insensitively against subscriptions.

locales.description: Language codes this placement targets. '*' = every locale. A placement shows when the resolved locale is in this list or the list contains '*'.

title.description: Optional display-name override, keyed by language. When absent the live channel title (from t.me/s or TDLib) is used.

description.description: Localized one-line blurb, keyed by language. Falls back to defaultLocale, then any value.

minVersionCode.description: Optional gate: clients with a smaller versionCode skip this placement. Lets future entries depend on app features not yet shipped.
